records.code_summary: Plan: I merged the three pipeline steps into a single cohesive script that loads and validates data, defines the SigLIP2 multimodal fusion architecture with separate tabular branches and attention-based modality fusion, and trains it using 5-fold stratified cross-validation with label smoothing and early stopping. The final script extracts frozen SigLIP2 embeddings from images, trains fold models on standardized tabular features plus image embeddings, generates OOF predictions for validation scoring, and produces the submission file with proper class ordering from the sample submission. Implementation signals: siglip, standardscaler, stratifiedkfold, kfold, label_smoothing, early stopping, optimize, oof. Primary libraries: numpy, pandas, torch, sklearn, pathlib, PIL, torchvision, warnings, os, transformers.
